import pytest
from target import url_basename

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "url,expected",
    [
        # simple cases
        ("http://example.com/foo", "foo"),
        ("https://example.com/foo", "foo"),
        ("http://example.com/foo/", "foo"),
        ("http://example.com/foo?bar=1", "foo"),
        ("http://example.com/foo#section", "foo"),
        ("http://example.com/foo?bar=1#section", "foo"),
        # multiple path segments – should return the last segment
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c", "c"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c/", "c"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c?x=1", "c"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c#frag", "c"),
        ("http://example.com/a/b/c?x=1#frag", "c"),
        # protocol‑relative URLs
        ("//example.com/foo", "foo"),
        ("//example.com/a/b/c", "c"),
        # edge cases: empty input, no path, only slash
        ("", ""),
        ("http://example.com", ""),
        ("http://example.com/", ""),
        # unsupported scheme – should not match
        ("ftp://example.com/foo", ""),
        # very long path
        (
            "http://example.com/" + "/".join([f"segment{i}" for i in range(100)]) + "/last",
            "last",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_url_basename_expected_output(url, expected):
    """The function should return the basename of the URL path as defined by the old implementation."""
    result = url_basename(url)
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert result == expected


def test_url_basename_unicode_empty():
    """Empty string input should return an empty Unicode string."""
    assert url_basename("") == u""


def test_url_basename_no_match_returns_empty():
    """Inputs that do not match the pattern should return an empty string."""
    # Missing leading slashes after scheme
    assert url_basename("http:/example.com/foo") == u""
    # Missing scheme and slashes
    assert url_basename("example.com/foo") == u""
    # Only scheme without host
    assert url_basename("http://") == u""


def test_url_basename_trailing_characters():
    """Characters after the basename that are not query/fragment should cause no match."""
    # Path followed by extra characters without ? or #
    assert url_basename("http://example.com/foo/bar") == "bar"
    # Path with extra characters after a slash but before query – should still capture last segment
    assert url_basename("http://example.com/foo/bar?x=1") == "bar"
